RadioTower3FSuperNerdText:
We have recordings
of the cries of

all #MON that
have been found.

We must have about
200 kinds.
RadioTower3FGymGuideText_Rockets:
To trainers, #-
MON are their beloved partners.

It's terrible how
TEAM ROCKET is

trying to control
#MON.
RadioTower3FGymGuideText:
We run 24 hours a
day to broadcast

entertaining pro-
grams.

I'll do my best to
run around the clock too!
RadioTower3FCooltrainerFPleaseSaveDirect:
The TEAM ROCKET
boss has locked himself in.

But the DIRECTOR
can open it.

He's up on the
fifth floor.

Please save him!
RadioTower3FCooltrainerFYoureMyHeroText:
Thank you!
You're my hero!

This is a token of
my appreciation.
RadioTower3FCooltrainerFItsSunnyDayText:
It's SUNNY DAY.
It powers up fire- type moves for a while.
GruntM7SeenText:
I've been given
strict orders.

I'm to crush any-
one who challenges TEAM ROCKET!
GruntM7AfterBattleText:
I failed in my
duties…

I'll be docked pay
for this…
GruntM8SeenText:
It feels great
ordering #MON to commit crimes.
GruntM8AfterBattleText:
I feel lousy over
losing!

Darn it! I hate
useless #MON!
GruntM9SeenText:
Why did the shut-
ter open? Did you

have something to
do with this?
GruntM9AfterBattleText:
What?! You made it
past our men in the UNDERGROUND?

How could you?
ScientistMarcSeenText:
An unknown child
wandering here?

Who are you?
ScientistMarcBeatenText:
Tch! I took you
too lightly!
ScientistMarcAfterBattleText:
Bwahahaha…

I can transmit as
strong a signal as I need from here.
